correctness.rationale: The zonotope perimeter identity holds for each direction; the conditional-azimuth inversion gives an exact CDF. Lagrange equations classify the only critical values (6 axes, 12 face diagonals, 8 space diagonals). Independent exact tangent-Hessian calculations yield coefficients -sqrt(2) and sqrt(2)-1 at the saddles, and -sqrt(6)/4 at maxima. Local coarea/Morse expansion gives 12/(4pi sqrt(2-sqrt(2))) times log(1/|p-p*|), with bounded remainder. Standard spherical cap areas give endpoint coefficients. A checker compared 160 independently constructed convex hull perimeters and numerical CDF and coefficient estimates.

value.rationale: The natural marginal shadow-perimeter law had earlier exact moments and numerical joint plots, but the geometry of its interior critical density was not resolved in inspected sources. The new unique logarithmic saddle and explicit positive residue are a structural feature of isotropic orientation measurement, and the exact one-dimensional CDF with endpoint exponents makes a calibratable model rather than a routine moment recomputation.
